features.title: Skilled leader
features.text: Envoys lead through words and example. They have many skills, with particular strength in persuading people or talking the party out of trouble.

features.title: Directives
features.text: Issue one directive each round to help allies attack or defend. Take its linked action to lead by example and strengthen the effect.
